attchmntText: Intimation of schedule of Investor Meet
voiceSummary: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited has intimated the schedule for an Analyst and Institutional Investor Meet. The company representatives will attend the Ambit Travel Ecosystem Conference on December 02, 2026. The meeting will be held in Mumbai in physical mode. It is classified as a one-to-one or group interaction. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during this event. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. This information is also available on the company website at www.theleela.com/investors.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith Press Release titled "The Leela Expands its Leisure Portfolio with two new signings in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands".
voiceSummary: Leela Palaces Hotels and Resorts Limited filed a press release regarding the signing of two new luxury resorts in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The company will manage these properties for the Sheeraj Group under hotel management agreements. The projects involve 160 keys across Sri Vijaya Puram and Shaheed Dweep. The Leela Sri Vijaya Puram, with 100 keys, is slated to open in 2029. The Leela Shaheed Dweep, with 60 keys, is expected to open in 2030. The developments are ground-up projects on long-term public-private partnership concessions with the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Integrated Development Corporation. This expansion strengthens the brand's presence in India's luxury leisure market.

attchmntText: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Scrutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
